energy_manifest.model: one real CAISO price/net-demand archetype shifted by target local wall time; price level unchanged
energy_manifest.capacity_model: Each Google cell curve is already normalized by its own source capacity. The curve is used as a utilization shape on an equal 100 MW proxy DC.
energy_manifest.workload_anchor: workload timestep 0 is assigned to experiment start UTC as a modeling convention; original Google UTC anchor was discarded
energy_manifest.net_demand_signed_scale: net_demand_mw divided by the maximum absolute net demand in the Pacific May-2025 reference window; clipped to [-1, 1]

1h.interpretation: Distribution across separate physical sites; regional net demand is not summed into a fictitious global grid.
